items.name: theme
items.title: Design tokens
items.description: 141 resolved semantic tokens (color, spacing, typography, motion, and more) every component in this registry depends on for theming.

items.name: aspect-ratio
items.title: AspectRatio
items.description: Keeps media at a fixed width-to-height ratio as the width changes, and holds the space before it loads

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: User profile picture with fallback to initials when no image is provided

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: Small status indicator or numeric count overlay attached to another element

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Trigger for user actions; renders as `<button>` or `<a>` depending on context

items.name: button-group
items.title: ButtonGroup
items.description: Related actions kept together: Undo / Redo, zoom out / in, Cancel / Save

items.name: calendar
items.title: Calendar
items.description: A month of days to choose one date or a range; the base for DatePicker and DateRangePicker

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: Single boolean selection with an associated label; supports indeterminate state

items.name: combobox
items.title: Combobox
items.description: One value from a long list, found by typing: a country, a town, a person

items.name: date-picker
items.title: DatePicker
items.description: A date typed or picked from a calendar: delivery dates, bookings, deadlines

items.name: date-range-picker
items.title: DateRangePicker
items.description: A start and an end date: a stay, a report period, leave

items.name: divider
items.title: Divider
items.description: A line that separates groups of content, horizontally or vertically

items.name: field
items.title: Field
items.description: Label, hint and error for any control, wired the way Input wires its own

items.name: file-upload
items.title: FileUpload
items.description: Pick files by button or by dragging them in, see what's chosen, and remove any

items.name: heading
items.title: Heading
items.description: Semantic heading element (H1–H5 visual sizes, any `<h1>`–`<h6>` tag) with a visual size decoupled from its document-outline level

items.name: icon-button
items.title: IconButton
items.description: An action shown only as an icon, for toolbars, cards and dense rows

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: Labelled single-line text entry with hint and error states

items.name: input-group
items.title: InputGroup
items.description: An Input joined to the text and buttons that belong to it: "https://", "kr.", an Apply button

items.name: kbd
items.title: Kbd
items.description: A key the user presses, drawn as a keycap

items.name: label
items.title: Label
items.description: Standalone form label element — used when a label must be decoupled from its input

items.name: link
items.title: Link
items.description: Navigation to another page or resource; use Link for navigation and Button for actions

items.name: multi-select
items.title: MultiSelect
items.description: Several values from a long list, found by typing: skills, reviewers, languages

items.name: number-input
items.title: NumberInput
items.description: A number typed or stepped: a quantity, an amount, a percentage

items.name: otp-input
items.title: OtpInput
items.description: A short code sent by text or email, shown as one box per character

items.name: progress-bar
items.title: ProgressBar
items.description: Shows how far a task has got, or that it's running when the end isn't known

items.name: radio
items.title: Radio
items.description: Single-selection control within a mutually exclusive group

items.name: search
items.title: Search
items.description: A site or list search: a search landmark with Enter to search, Escape to clear and an optional shortcut

items.name: segmented-control
items.title: SegmentedControl
items.description: One choice from a few, shown side by side: a view switch, a time range

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: Dropdown for choosing a single value from a list; supports grouped options

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: Placeholder loading state that mirrors the geometry of the content it replaces

items.name: skip-link
items.title: SkipLink
items.description: First Tab stop on the page that lets keyboard users jump past the header to the main content

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: One value from a range, by dragging or with the keyboard: volume, a price limit, opacity

items.name: spinner
items.title: Spinner
items.description: Indeterminate loading indicator for in-progress operations

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: Binary toggle for on/off settings; renders as a styled checkbox under the hood

items.name: tag
items.title: Tag
items.description: A short label on content: a category, a status word, a chosen value; optionally removable or clickable

items.name: tag-input
items.title: TagInput
items.description: Free-text values as tags: keywords, email addresses, ingredients

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: Multi-line text entry with label, hint, and error states — mirrors Input API

items.name: time-picker
items.title: TimePicker
items.description: One time of day: an appointment, a delivery slot, opening hours

items.name: toggle-button
items.title: ToggleButton
items.description: A button that stays on or off, like bold in an editor or a grid overlay

items.name: visually-hidden
items.title: VisuallyHidden
items.description: Text screen readers announce but sighted users don't see

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: Contextual inline feedback message with semantic severity levels (info, success, warning, error)

items.name: alert-dialog
items.title: AlertDialog
items.description: Confirmation gate for an action the user must explicitly accept or decline — real `alertdialog` role, no outside-click/close-button dismiss, unlike Dialog

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: Compound container for grouped content — composed from named sub-components

items.name: command-palette
items.title: CommandPalette
items.description: Every action in an app, one search away: Ctrl+K or ⌘K, a few letters, Enter

items.name: context-menu
items.title: ContextMenu
items.description: The actions for one thing, opened where the pointer is: a file row, a card, a canvas

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: Overlay for tasks or information requiring focused attention

items.name: drawer
items.title: Drawer
items.description: Side-anchored slide-in panel for supplemental content or secondary navigation

items.name: hover-card
items.title: HoverCard
items.description: A preview of what a link leads to: a person's profile, a page's summary

items.name: lightbox
items.title: Lightbox
items.description: Images large, one at a time, over the page: a product's photos, a portfolio piece

items.name: menu
items.title: Menu
items.description: Dropdown list of actions opened from a trigger: account menus, overflow ("more") menus, row actions

items.name: navigation-menu
items.title: NavigationMenu
items.description: The site's header navigation: top-level links, plus groups that open a dropdown of links. Hidden below 1024px, where SideNav's drawer carries the same links (its `headerItems`)

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: Content shown next to its trigger without blocking the page: a filter panel, a date picker, a short form

items.name: theme-scope
items.title: ThemeScope
items.description: Gives one part of a page its own brand, mode, or both; overlays opened inside it (Dialog, Drawer, AlertDialog, Menu, Select, Tooltip) take the same, although they render at the end of the page

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: Ephemeral notification pushed to a corner of the viewport; auto-dismisses after a timeout

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: Contextual label revealed on hover or focus — supplements an icon or truncated text

items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: Collapsible content sections with animated expand/collapse; supports single or multi-open modes

items.name: breadcrumb
items.title: Breadcrumb
items.description: Hierarchical page location trail; the last item is the current page (non-linked)

items.name: carousel
items.title: Carousel
items.description: A row of slides shown a few at a time, moved with buttons, dots, swipe or arrow keys

items.name: data-table
items.title: DataTable
items.description: Sortable, filterable, paginated table for structured datasets

items.name: empty-state
items.title: EmptyState
items.description: Placeholder for zero-content states — icon, heading, supporting text, and an optional action

items.name: form-layout
items.title: FormLayout
items.description: The frame of a form: spacing, sections, rows, actions, and an error summary after a failed submit

items.name: hero
items.title: Hero
items.description: Page-level section header with eyebrow, title, lead text, and an action slot

items.name: mobile-nav
items.title: MobileNav
items.description: The bar at the bottom of a small screen with an app's main places

items.name: pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: Page navigation controls for multi-page data sets; exposes current page and total page count

items.name: side-nav
items.title: SideNav
items.description: Section navigation: inline beside the content (240px wide) from 1024px up; below that, in a left Drawer opened by `SideNavTrigger`, which hides itself from 1024px up. Wrap both in `SideNavProvider`

items.name: stepper
items.title: Stepper
items.description: Where someone is in a process with a fixed order: checkout, sign-up, an application

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: Static data table with semantic header, body, and row structure

items.name: table-of-contents
items.title: TableOfContents
items.description: The sections of a long page as links, with the one being read marked: docs, articles, policies

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Segmented view switcher with full keyboard navigation; built on Radix Tabs

items.name: toolbar
items.title: Toolbar
items.description: A row of controls for one area: the formatting buttons over an editor, the actions over a table or canvas

items.name: top-nav
items.title: TopNav
items.description: The bar across the top of a site or app: brand, main navigation, actions
